scope: Source-level screening for the technology catalog. Decisions and scored comparisons remain in TECHNOLOGY_INFRASTRUCTURE.md, TECHNOLOGY_CLINICAL.md and TECHNOLOGY_SCIENCE.md. Actual installed artifacts have separate rights registers.
method: Commit and tag are source coordinates. Repository-reported SPDX is the upstream default-branch classifier and may differ from terms at the pinned revision. Resolve each license_evidence path at source_commit and verify its Git blob ID. DESCRIPTION is package metadata. Empty evidence or NOASSERTION requires manual qualification. Manifest counts refer only to the stated section, including workspace-root effects. They exclude transitive resolution, platform conditions, native linkage and deployment permission.
